comment: Every published measurement and the exact command that re-derives it from committed data
(na-8qo). scripts/score_published.py runs this file on a host with no game install; a run
directory that is not listed here is a FAILURE, not an omission, so a new row cannot be
published without saying how it is re-derived.
`derives` entries must be runnable with SMAC_PLAY_DIR unset, no model key, no Wine and no
sibling checkout. `retained` records what was kept and what was thrown away, because the
raw material for some of these is game files we deliberately do not commit.

runs.retained: the per-turn observation logs for all three arms. NOT the 2.8GB game copy or its autosaves — the numbers in the table come only from the logs.
the census NUMBERS in results.jsonl.census, not the .sav files they were read from. The autosaves live outside the repo at ~/workspace/na-runs/ and the table does not depend on them.

tables: ranking grounding by information value — WITHDRAWN
runs.retained: offered/answers fixtures kept so the withdrawal is checkable. No table is published from this run any more: NOTES.md withdraws the finding and says the experiment could not decide the question. Nothing to re-derive, and that is the honest entry rather than a scoring command that would imply a live result.

tables: action_space cost fixture — the correction behind na-373's withdrawal
runs.retained: fixtures only; the finding is prose in NOTES.md.
offered/answers/task fixtures for every arm, plus manifest.json. Scored by reading the committed answers; no numeric table is published.

tables: base_production grounding arms at turns 42 and 135
runs.retained: offered/answers/task fixtures per arm. Findings are prose in NOTES.md.
observations plus the ablated log. Findings are prose in NOTES.md.
